name: Birgi
description: A storyteller who is really a goddess, with amethyst eyes and shimmering tattoos, who provokes a brawl between Kannah and Omenseekers.

description_citations.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
description_citations.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Birgi tells the saga of Thura Sail-Rend, and Niko plays with a cat using conjured mirrors.
timeline.quote: Thura would not escape death that day, for only death draws the attention of the Valkyries

citation.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
citation.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Birgi joins Niko and Kjell, who explains Fynn's dream that the Cosmos Serpent will break its cage and swallow the light of Starnheim.
timeline.quote: The Cosmos Serpent will break its cage and the first thing it swallows will be the light.

citation.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
citation.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Birgi leads Niko and Kjell outside; Omenseekers mock Fynn and the Kannah, and a brawl erupts.
timeline.quote: the insult died between a Kannah forehead and an Omenseeker face

citation.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
citation.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Niko realizes Birgi provoked the fight and fends off attackers with mirror traps to protect Kjell.
timeline.quote: Niko grabbed a shard in each hand, stretching each into a dagger

citation.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
citation.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Niko shoves Birgi, who reveals she is a goddess and says she did this so Niko may know them.
timeline.quote: I did this so you may know us. Our joy, our rage—how little lies between.

citation.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
citation.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.
